lines.raw: The idea in one sentence.
lines.say: The idea in one sentence.

lines.raw: An **APC (Ambulatory Payment Classification)** groups each hospital outpatient service with similar services of similar cost, and a **status indicator** on each service says whether it is paid on its own, folded into another service, or swept into one payment for the whole visit.
lines.say: An A P C (Ambulatory Payment Classification) groups each hospital outpatient service with similar services of similar cost, and a status indicator on each service says whether it is paid on its own, folded into another service, or swept into one payment for the whole visit.

lines.raw: The US version: APCs under OPPS.
lines.say: The U S version: A P C's under O P P S.

scenes.section: The US version: APCs under OPPS

lines.raw: In the US: How it works.
lines.say: In the U S: How it works.

lines.raw: Medicare pays hospital outpatient departments through the **OPPS (Outpatient Prospective Payment System)**, which started in 2000.
lines.say: Medicare pays hospital outpatient departments through the O P P S (Outpatient Prospective Payment System), which started in 2000.

lines.raw: Each outpatient service on the claim is coded with a **CPT or HCPCS** code.
lines.say: Each outpatient service on the claim is coded with a C P T or H C P C S code.

lines.raw: Medicare assigns each code to **one APC** and gives it a **status indicator**.
lines.say: Medicare assigns each code to one A P C and gives it a status indicator.

lines.raw: Unlike a DRG (one group per stay), an outpatient claim can carry **several APCs**, one for each separately paid service.
lines.say: Unlike a D R G (one group per stay), an outpatient claim can carry several A P C's, one for each separately paid service.

lines.raw: The APC list, assignments and status indicators are updated every **calendar year** (1 January), with smaller updates each quarter.
lines.say: The A P C list, assignments and status indicators are updated every calendar year (1 January), with smaller updates each quarter.

lines.raw: Doctors' own bills are **not** grouped into APCs; they are paid from a fee schedule (see the Fee For Service course).
lines.say: Doctors' own bills are not grouped into A P C's; they are paid from a fee schedule (see the Fee For Service course).

scenes.section: The US version: APCs under OPPS

lines.raw: Common status indicators (a selection).
lines.say: Common status indicators (a selection).

lines.raw: `V`. Meaning: Clinic or emergency department visit, paid separately. Example: A hospital clinic visit.
lines.say: V. Meaning: Clinic or emergency department visit, paid separately. Example: A hospital clinic visit.

lines.raw: `S`. Meaning: Significant procedure, paid separately, no discount when several are done. Example: A radiation therapy treatment.
lines.say: S. Meaning: Significant procedure, paid separately, no discount when several are done. Example: A radiation therapy treatment.

lines.raw: `T`. Meaning: Significant procedure, paid separately, **multiple-procedure discount** applies. Example: A joint injection or a small surgical procedure.
lines.say: T. Meaning: Significant procedure, paid separately, multiple-procedure discount applies. Example: A joint injection or a small surgical procedure.

lines.raw: `N`. Meaning: **Packaged**: no separate payment; its cost is included in other services. Example: Supplies, many low-cost drugs.
lines.say: N. Meaning: Packaged: no separate payment; its cost is included in other services. Example: Supplies, many low-cost drugs.

lines.raw: `J1`. Meaning: **Comprehensive APC**: one payment for the main procedure, with nearly everything else on the claim packaged into it. Example: Major outpatient surgery, such as a knee replacement done as an outpatient.
lines.say: J1. Meaning: Comprehensive A P C: one payment for the main procedure, with nearly everything else on the claim packaged into it. Example: Major outpatient surgery, such as a knee replacement done as an outpatient.

lines.raw: Packaging.

lines.raw: Including the cost of small or supporting services in the payment for the main service, instead of paying them one by one.
lines.say: Including the cost of small or supporting services in the payment for the main service, instead of paying them one by one.

lines.raw: Comprehensive APC (C-APC).
lines.say: Comprehensive A P C (C-APC).

lines.raw: An APC that covers a whole outpatient claim around one major procedure, similar in spirit to a DRG for an outpatient visit.
lines.say: An A P C that covers a whole outpatient claim around one major procedure, similar in spirit to a D R G for an outpatient visit.

lines.raw: ASC (ambulatory surgery center).
lines.say: A S C (ambulatory surgery center).

lines.raw: A stand-alone surgery centre, not part of a hospital.
lines.say: A stand-alone surgery centre, not part of a hospital.

lines.raw: Medicare pays ASCs with a related system based on the same groups.
lines.say: Medicare pays A S C's with a related system based on the same groups.

lines.raw: EAPG (Enhanced Ambulatory Patient Groups).
lines.say: E A P G (Enhanced Ambulatory Patient Groups).

lines.raw: A licensed outpatient grouper used by some Medicaid programmes and insurers.
lines.say: A licensed outpatient grouper used by some Medicaid programmes and insurers.

lines.raw: It groups services within each visit and applies its own packaging rules.
lines.say: It groups services within each visit and applies its own packaging rules.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: APCs group hospital outpatient services under Medicare's OPPS; one claim can have several APCs.
lines.say: A P C's group hospital outpatient services under Medicare's O P P S; one claim can have several A P C's.

lines.raw: Each service has a status indicator: paid separately, packaged, or comprehensive.
lines.say: Each service has a status indicator: paid separately, packaged, or comprehensive.

lines.raw: Packaged lines show $0 paid because their cost is included in another line.
lines.say: Packaged lines show 0 dollars paid because their cost is included in another line.

lines.raw: Comprehensive APCs (J1) pay one amount for a whole claim around a major procedure.
lines.say: Comprehensive A P C's (J1) pay one amount for a whole claim around a major procedure.

lines.raw: APCs update every calendar year; other outpatient groupers such as EAPGs are used by some payers.
lines.say: A P C's update every calendar year; other outpatient groupers such as E A P G's are used by some payers.
